start.connected: This chat is already linked to the web. Send status for details.
start.hello: Hi. Send wired to link your web account, or send help for commands.

status.unwired:
Not linked.
Send wired to link your web account, or send help for commands.
Server: reachable.
status.offlineWired:
Server unreachable, showing last known state: linked.
The link may have changed on the other side. Send status again shortly.
status.offlineUnwired:
Server unreachable, showing last known state: not linked.
Send status again shortly.

help.text:
Commands (prefix with /):
/wired: link this chat (then send the web code OR a Telegram/Discord/WhatsApp code)
/newcode: show a code to enter on the web OR on another platform
/status: full link info
/menu: show this list again
/disconnect: close the link on both sides
/delete: reply to one of YOUR messages with this command to delete it on both sides
/anon: chat with a random stranger
/next: skip to the next stranger
/stop: leave the stranger chat

Pairing codes (XXXX-XXXX) need no prefix. Anything else is forwarded to the linked peer as chat.

One WhatsApp sender links to exactly one web account OR one platform peer. Either side can disconnect.

wired.alreadyLinked: This account is already linked to the web.
wired.askCode: Send a code here (example WXYZ-1234): a web code, or a code from Telegram/Discord/WhatsApp. Or send newcode to show a code here.
wired.codeMessage:
Your code: {code}
Valid for {minutes} minutes. Enter it on the web OR on Telegram/Discord/WhatsApp to link.
wired.linked:
Linked to {account} on the web ✅
Everything here is forwarded both ways. Send status for details.
wired.invalidFormat: Wrong code format. A valid example is WXYZ-1234.
wired.unknownCode: Unknown or expired code. Get a fresh code on the web and send it again here.
wired.rejectedCode: The code was rejected. Get a fresh code on the web and send it again here.

disconnect.done: Disconnected on both sides. The web room is closed too. Send wired to link again any time.
disconnect.fromWeb: Disconnected from the web. This chat no longer receives web messages. Send wired to link again.
disconnect.incomplete: Could not reach the server, so the link may still be active. Try disconnect again.

media.notLinked: This account is not linked yet. Send wired first.
media.linkExpired: This link was closed on the other side. Send wired to link again.
media.tooBigDownload: That file is over 20MB, it cannot be downloaded.
media.tooBigForward: That file is over 50MB, it cannot be forwarded.
media.downloadFailed: Could not download that file from WhatsApp. Please resend it.
media.unsupported: That message type is not supported yet.
media.backendDown: The backend is unreachable. Your message is kept, try sending it again shortly.
media.inactiveSession: WhatsApp session is not active on the server. Ask the owner to run session:add and scan again.

common.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
common.rateLimitedAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
common.backendDown: The backend is unreachable. Try again shortly.

delete.done: Deleted on both sides. The web copy is gone too.
delete.notFound: That message is not in the bridged room (it may already be deleted).
delete.forbidden: You can only delete your own messages.

anon.searching: Looking for a stranger… I'll ping you the moment someone is found. Send stop to cancel.
anon.found:
Partner found! Session {session} · they are on {partner}.
Anything you send now goes to them anonymously. Send next for someone new, stop to quit.
anon.already: You are already chatting with a stranger (session {session} · {partner}). Send next for someone new, stop to quit.
anon.ended: The stranger left (session {session}). Send anon to find someone new.
anon.stopped: Anon chat off. Your messages stay on both devices. Send anon to start again.
anon.cancelled: Search cancelled. Send anon to try again later.
anon.notInQueue: You are not in anon chat. Send anon to find a stranger.
anon.busy: You are in another chat. Disconnect it first, then send anon.
